verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe running Claude Code on the web with no local setup, where you kick off long-running tasks and check back later, including repos not cloned locally and parallel tasks (docs-26, docs-14). Cloud sessions can be started from the desktop app (docs-13), and a web or mobile task can be pulled into the terminal with `claude --teleport` (docs-10). missing for 10: explicit documentation that the cloud environment is isolated or sandboxed (the sandboxing doc covers only the local Bash tool), details of the cloud environment's configuration and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of cloud background runs.
